name: BeenVerified

search.notes: The opt-out flow has its own search by name and state.

steps: Search by first name, last name and state.
Select the matching record and choose to proceed with opt-out.
Enter an email address and complete the human check yourself.
Click the verification link in the email within about 48 hours.
optout.notes: identity-eraser reports one opt-out per email address and a link that expires in about 48 hours. The California registry lists PeopleLooker, PeopleSmart, NeighborWho, Ownerly, NumberGuru and Bumper under BeenVerified, LLC, but no source confirms one opt-out covers them, so treat them as separate.

sources.attribution: California Privacy Protection Agency data broker registry, 2026 list fetched 2026-10-27
